notes: Definitions: EBIT is proxied by operating income from the consolidated statements of income. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1145197/000114519726000028/podd-20251231.htm))
D&A uses GAAP depreciation and amortization from the consolidated statements of cash flows. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1145197/000114519726000028/podd-20251231.htm))
Capex uses 'Capital expenditures' from the consolidated statements of cash flows. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1145197/000114519726000028/podd-20251231.htm))

NWC construction (modeling assumption): NWC = (Total current assets − Cash and cash equivalents) − (Total current liabilities − current portion of long-term debt). This excludes cash and debt from working capital. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1145197/000114519726000028/podd-20251231.htm))

Tax rate: base-case uses FY 2025 effective tax rate of 27.2% (GAAP), which may not equal a normalized cash tax rate given valuation allowance dynamics and one-time items. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1145197/000114519726000028/podd-20251231.htm))
WACC and NOL utilization percent are judgmental inputs (not directly sourced from filings). They are set to be economically reasonable for a medtech growth profile.

Investments field: set to FY 2025 'Investments in developed software' (other investing items like 'Acquisition of other intangible assets' are not included in this single parameter). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1145197/000114519726000028/podd-20251231.htm))
Comps: NTM EV/Revenue, EV/EBITDA, and NTM P/E were not captured from primary/official sources during this run; set to null to avoid fabrication.

catalysts: Incremental evidence of Omnipod 5 adoption momentum (including international share gains) that keeps near-term growth above decelerating assumptions. ([s201.q4cdn.com](https://s201.q4cdn.com/452214269/files/doc_news/Insulet-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results-2026.pdf))

Follow-through on adjusted operating margin expansion (pricing/mix and cost discipline) that accelerates path to the target EBIT margin. ([s201.q4cdn.com](https://s201.q4cdn.com/452214269/files/doc_news/Insulet-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results-2026.pdf))
Manufacturing capacity and supply chain execution reducing unit-cost pressure as capex scales. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1145197/000114519726000028/podd-20251231.htm))
company_overview: Insulet develops, manufactures, and sells the Omnipod tubeless insulin delivery system for insulin-dependent diabetes. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1145197/000114519726000028/podd-20251231.htm))

Omnipod products use a wearable, self-adhesive disposable Pod that provides insulin delivery for up to three days without needles/painful injections. ([s201.q4cdn.com](https://s201.q4cdn.com/452214269/files/doc_news/Insulet-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results-2026.pdf))

Omnipod 5 is the company’s flagship Automated Insulin Delivery system integrating with a continuous glucose monitor and smartphone/Omnipod Controller. ([s201.q4cdn.com](https://s201.q4cdn.com/452214269/files/doc_news/Insulet-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results-2026.pdf))
current_context: FY 2025 revenue was $2.7 billion (+30.7% reported; +29.5% constant currency) and operating income was $473.8 million (17.5% of revenue). ([s201.q4cdn.com](https://s201.q4cdn.com/452214269/files/doc_news/Insulet-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results-2026.pdf))

FY 2026 guidance (constant currency) calls for total revenue growth of 20% to 22%, with adjusted operating margin ~100 bps YoY expansion. ([s201.q4cdn.com](https://s201.q4cdn.com/452214269/files/doc_news/Insulet-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results-2026.pdf))
investment_highlights: Base case assumes continued Omnipod 5 adoption and expanding international distribution, consistent with company’s 2026 revenue growth outlook. ([s201.q4cdn.com](https://s201.q4cdn.com/452214269/files/doc_news/Insulet-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results-2026.pdf))

EBIT margin expands from the mid-to-high teens toward ~19.5% as operating leverage offsets elevated reinvestment needs. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1145197/000114519726000028/podd-20251231.htm))

Capex increases near-term to support manufacturing/supply chain scale, then normalizes as revenue grows. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1145197/000114519726000028/podd-20251231.htm))

Working capital intensity improves (declining NWC% of sales) reflecting scale and growing revenue base. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1145197/000114519726000028/podd-20251231.htm))
key_risks: Reimbursement and payer coverage dynamics could pressure demand, utilization, and gross-to-operating leverage. ([investors.insulet.com](https://investors.insulet.com/news/news-details/2026/Insulet-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))

Competitive pressure (alternative insulin delivery modalities and technology cycles) could slow adoption and margins. ([investors.insulet.com](https://investors.insulet.com/news/news-details/2026/Insulet-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))

Manufacturing execution/supply chain risks could delay product deliveries or increase costs. ([investors.insulet.com](https://investors.insulet.com/news/news-details/2026/Insulet-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))

valuation_summary: DCF base case is anchored on the last historical year (FY 2025) and a conservative revenue growth deceleration profile aligned with management’s 2026 growth range. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1145197/000114519726000028/podd-20251231.htm))

Terminal economics assume sustained growth of 3% with a 9% WACC, targeting an economically sensible steady-state margin near the company’s direction of travel. ([s201.q4cdn.com](https://s201.q4cdn.com/452214269/files/doc_news/Insulet-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results-2026.pdf))
